newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices rise.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume leapt to 1,045 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 585 kilos amid fresh demand ahead of the weekend and wide fluctuations in prices, dealers said.
Gold edged higher to $362.00 an ounce at the close from Thursday's $361.90 and jumped in lira terms to 1,424,000 lira per gram from 1,405,500 at Thursday's close.
Dealers said dollar term prices, which fluctuated between $356 and $368 in the day, also spurred activity. Of total volume, 72.7 percent was in dollar terms.
Dealers said a weaker lira, which ended at 122,410 to the dollar against Thursday's 122,090, lifted gold prices in lira terms.
The afternoon session saw 525 kilos of trade after 520 in the morning.
